messages.content:
Reword the question so that it asks exactly the same thing in different words and a different sentence
structure. Keep every name, model, position number, article number, date and condition exactly. Do not add or
remove any detail. Return only the reworded question.
From which date does Article 50(1) of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 (Member States' duty to lay down penalties) apply?

response.text: As of which date does Article 50(1) of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, which requires Member States to lay down penalties, become applicable?
